title: Independent author acceptance of the widened evaluator contracts
summary: The original author-before-builder rule was missed for three historical evaluator changes; that history remains explicit. A separate author reviewed the complete evaluator diffs against declarations and original planted guards, found and corrected two bounded schema/refusal gaps, and accepted the resulting local contract without changing fixtures, journeys, handlers, performance or call-count policy.
proves: The new public evaluator guards fail first for a known refusal missing its tag/code and schema-valued string/JSON ambiguity. A partial-telemetry guard also rejects a broad body-first draft before the narrower correction. The final 21 pure evaluator/watch guards, independent probes and 16 real workerd/Collector planted/list/privacy tests pass. Original eight negative fixtures still fail their named evals, blank scaffolds fail, and every operation retains nine evals. Static checks and ownership-scoped cleanup pass. Historical authorship is not rewritten; full integrated gate/CI/review remain the conductor's work.
